paper.title_en: Ultralight Boson Ionization from Comparable-Mass Binaries
paper.abstract_en: Detection of gravitational waves enables probes of environmental effects around compact binaries. Ultralight bosons, well motivated in particle physics and capable of forming core-like dark matter structures, induce environmental dynamics that differ qualitatively from those produced by stars or particle dark matter. For comparable-mass binaries, such bosons can form gravitationally bound states analogous to molecules once the binary separation falls below the characteristic wavelength of the bound states, with an inner region co-moving with the binary. We combine numerical simulations and a semi-analytic framework to characterize the structure and ionization of these gravitational molecules. We determine the extent of the co-moving region and compute the ionization flux driven by orbital motion over a range of eccentricities. Using these results, we estimate the backreaction on the binary orbital evolution and identify a new environmental effect: eccentricity-induced ionization of the co-moving component leads to efficient circularization. We further show that this molecular phase can be astrophysically viable and significantly modify the stochastic gravitational wave background from supermassive black hole binaries.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该论文研究超轻玻色子对并合双星的影响，涉及引力波背景和黑洞双星动力学，与主题相关，且具有理论深度和新颖性。
decision.title_zh: 超轻玻色子从质量可比双星中的电离
decision.abstract_zh: 引力波的探测使得研究致密双星周围的环境效应成为可能。超轻玻色子在粒子物理学中具有充分动机，并且能够形成类似核心的暗物质结构，其引发的环境动力学与恒星或粒子暗物质所产生的动力学有质的区别。对于质量可比的双星，当双星间距降至束缚态的特征波长以下时，这类玻色子可以形成类似于分子的引力束缚态，其中内部区域与双星共同运动。我们结合数值模拟和半解析框架来表征这些引力分子的结构和电离。我们确定了共同运动区域的范围，并计算了在多种偏心率范围内由轨道运动驱动的电离通量。利用这些结果，我们估计了对双星轨道演化的反作用，并识别出一种新的环境效应：由偏心率引起的共同运动成分的电离导致高效的圆化。我们进一步表明，这种分子相在天体物理上是可行的，并且能够显著改变来自超大质量黑洞双星的随机引力波背景。
